papers.title: ComBodied Agents: a New Paradigm of Human-Centric Agentic AI
papers.abstract: Integrates digital and embodied tools to model individual human-state trajectories over time, providing proportionate, consent-aware support through event-based perception and intervention policies.

papers.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design
papers.abstract: Survey of multi-component self-evolution where agents and environments impose adaptive pressure on one another, progressively removing human constraints across three evolutionary stages.

papers.title: Articulated Object Reconstruction from Rest-State Observation
papers.abstract: Reconstructs articulated objects from single closed configurations using vision-language fusion, diffusion-based motion synthesis, and geometric consistency validation without observed motion.

papers.title: AdvFD: Boosting Visual Generation via Adversarial Fréchet Distance Loss
papers.abstract: Improves generator post-training by adding learnable adversarial feature spaces to static Fréchet losses, with whitening to stabilize optimization across different model scales.

papers.title: Ex-Omni-2D: Expressive Omni-Modal Dialogue Models with Native Visual Presence
papers.abstract: Generates coordinated text, speech, and video responses via Visual Thought Plans and distilled streaming video generation, achieving practical real-time performance on multi-GPU systems.

papers.title: Decoding-Level Taboo: A Diagnostic Stress Test for LLM Robustness
papers.abstract: Runtime logit-space stress test revealing how large language models handle off-nominal generation paths, showing robustness depends on scale and instruction alignment.

papers.title: Not Worth Another Token: Marginal Value Estimation for Efficient Deep Research Agents
papers.abstract: Pruning strategies applied at different pipeline stages reduce token usage and latency in long-horizon research agents, with early pruning yielding greatest efficiency gains.

papers.title: SkillZip: Evaluation-Free Skill Compression for Self-Evolving Agents by Discovering Reusable Structure
papers.abstract: Compresses self-evolving agent skills by finding minimal faithful structural explanations that share repeated rules and procedures while preserving rare exceptions.

papers.title: UniMoMo: Expert Merging-Based MoE Acceleration for Large Recommendation Models
papers.abstract: Post-training compression framework that groups experts by functional similarity and applies layer-adaptive protection, achieving near-teacher accuracy with smaller indexes.

papers.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding
papers.abstract: Framework treating visual resolution as adaptive reasoning-time resource, starting low-resolution and selectively zooming into high-resolution regions without external retrievers.

cc_updates.body: Documented `claude remote-control --continue` for resuming sessions. Added server-supplied Claude Code hook support for self-hosted runners. Added SSE keepalive pings to gateway streaming responses during long thinking pauses. Added plugin marketplace `command` sources for local commands. `ListAgents` now marks disconnected Remote Control sessions as `offline` and labels cloud sessions as `cloud`. Fixed long responses partly disappearing while streaming. Fixed crashes on Windows with extended-length paths. Fixed auto mode failing with disabled attribution headers. Fixed MCP OAuth with strict authorization servers using 127.0.0.1. Fixed Remote Control clients showing stuck spinner after slash commands. Fixed Claude Code Review workflow not posting reviews. Fixed multi-second UI stalls with thousands of IDE diagnostics. Fixed file-watcher handle leaks and Windows scheduled-tasks watcher errors.

Fixed interactive sessions that could stop redrawing entirely after rare internal layout errors. Fixed `git` / Git Bash not being found on Windows when Claude Code is launched from parent folder of git installation. Fixed `/tui` reverting session to earlier model when `/model` had been changed. Fixed cross-session messaging sometimes starting without inbox in first session after install or upgrade. Fixed Remote Control `/resume` while connected leaking conversation title or history into connected session. Hardened skills synced from claude.ai: no longer shadow local commands or MCP prompts, descriptions sanitized/labeled, bodies don't run `!` commands or expand `@` files. Improved cross-session messages display. Improved Vertex AI credential handling. Changed Write tool to allow newer models overwriting existing files without reading first.

Fixed feature flags being evaluated without user's subscription tier when session started with expired login token, wrongly prompting Max plan users for usage credits. Fixed every Bash command failing under `claude-code-action` with `allowed_non_write_users` on GitHub-hosted runners. Fixed `/tui` bringing back conversation rewound to before first message. Improved slash-command menu: blue marks only selected row, matched characters bolded instead of recolored, emoji/accented names keep glyphs. Improved performance: fewer event-loop stalls on file-not-found suggestions and at-mention size checks.
